description.value: Hyatt Grand Central New York is a hotel located at 109 East 42nd Street in Midtown Manhattan. The building stands adjoining Grand Central Terminal, so trains and subways are steps away. It suits a trip that mixes Midtown sightseeing with day trips by rail.
